notes: Missing grid intervals are blank, never zero-filled.

Eastern source timestamps have no UTC offset. Repeated fall daylight-saving hour cannot be assigned unambiguously; those original records are preserved separately and both possible UTC hours are flagged.
mean_kw_available uses available observed intervals only; estimated_energy_kwh_complete_hour is populated only for complete, unambiguous hours.
This is a large public library building, not a small business. No measured PV, battery or weather is included.
